citations.assessment: The checked Bavli gives Rav Assi son of Rabbi Chanina on the planting penalty not passing to his son.
The text has Rav Acha bar Avya before Rabbi Assi and cites Rabbi Assi bar Chanina about a boundary. The adjacent name and named reporter remain distinct.
The comparison attests an Acha bar Rav Avya dispatch about inheritance. This locus does not include the title chain in the 56a encounter.
These inheritance passages name or refer back to the Acha dispatch. They do not repeat the distinct 56a form.
In the checked edition this passage is 1:9:5 and has Rabbi Zeura in the name of Rabbi Immi bar Chinena. Keep the original halakhah number and tentative equivalence.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015
